name: Autodrom Sosnová v16.0
description: Autodrom Sosnová near Česká Lípa, Czech Republic, as it really is: every piece of asphalt with its real outline and width from the 12.5 cm aerial photo of the Czech state survey, the real concrete strips, sand run-offs and tyre walls, the laser-scanned landscape and the buildings with their real roofs. The original circuit with nothing added: no race set-up, every road open. The AI line (1764 m, anticlockwise) takes the long route under the green bridge. 16 grid slots, 16 pit boxes, lap timing at the start line. Data: ČÚZK (CC BY 4.0), materials from Poly Haven (CC0). Optional CSP grass and rain. Not affiliated with the circuit owner.
author: Sosnova track kit (data: ČÚZK Ortofoto ČR + DMR 5G, CC BY 4.0)
